caseName: Interstate Commerce Comm'n v. Pennsylvania Railroad
caseNameFull: Interstate Commerce Comm'n v. Pennsylvania Railroad Co.
attorneys: Mr. Daniel W. Knowlton, with whom Messrs. William H. Bonneville, H. L. Underwood, and E. M. Ebert were on the brief, for petitioner. Mr. Henry Wolf Biklé, with whom Messrs. F. D. McKenney and C. B. Heiserman were on the brief, for respondents.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Decree affirmed, by an equally divided Court. Mr. Justice Roberts took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
